content.text: The visible suite now passes. I changed one line in `solution/core.py`: the `_expired` method compared age with `>`, so an entry whose age was exactly the TTL was still returned by `get`. I changed it to `>=`, which makes an entry expire at exactly TTL, as the test expects. `_expired` is used by `get`, `put` and `_purge`, so all three now treat an entry at exactly TTL as expired. Nothing under `tests/` was touched, no dependencies were added, and the `TTLCache` public API is unchanged. I did not run the hidden suite, so the boundary behaviour for other cases is untested beyond this one assertion.
